playstyle: Oppressive rushdown. Freeze the opponent with plus-on-block mids (d+1, f,f,F+2, SNK.4, f,F+3), then open them up with throws, Feint & Catch and his lows. His pressure tools are fairly slow, so watch for interrupts and do not be predictable.

stances.name: Sneak
stances.note: SNK.4 is a Heat Engager and +7 on block; SNK.2 tornadoes on hit.

keyMoves: Up close to keep the turn.
i13 mid, -2 on block; can enter Prowl (PGR) with 3+4.
Bunker-buster Elbow: i18 mid, +1c on block.
To keep the turn after a blocked string.
Interrupt with a fast move or step.
One of his core pressure moves.
Russian Assault: i15 mid from a run, +4 on block, launches on counter hit (+44a).
Rushdown mid that is plus and launches on CH (Wavu: wr2).
To close distance and keep the turn.
When the opponent is ready to step: it is linear-ish.
Scimitar: i15 launcher, launches crouchers too. -12 on block.
Ballistic Upper: i15 while-standing launcher, -12 on block.
Gelid Smash: i11 while-standing mid, -5 on block.
Counterstrike: i20 high that sidesteps left, launches on counter hit (+53a).
Razer: i18 low, -13 on block, +13g on counter hit.
Ignition Switch: Heat Engager from Sneak, +7 on block.
From SNK to keep the turn and start Heat.
Getting interrupted on the way into SNK.
Frost Tackle: i12 while-standing Heat Engager.
Feint & Catch: an attack throw at the end of 1,3,2, unbreakable in Heat (Wavu).
His mix-up between strings and a throw.
Against people who block the whole string.
A key part of his pressure.
Purge Slam: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
Throws are a big part of his game.
